critique-full-v1:
This is a screenshot of a web page. Read only the picture — do not open any files or read any code.

Give design feedback across several angles: layout and spacing, visual hierarchy, contrast, alignment, empty or dead space, missing backgrounds or boundaries, general UI/UX, and imagery. Write three to six sentences of plain prose describing what you actually see, naming specific elements.

Then list findings as a JSON block. Each finding is `{class, what, where, sel, decl}` — `class` is `"broken"` for something clearly wrong or `"maybe"` for something that might be better. `sel` is your best guess at the CSS selector; `decl` is a proposed one-line fix if you have one, else null. No overall score.
